battery_basis: 10Ah x assumed 3.6V cell nominal; 75-90% conversion, 85-100% usable capacity. Not 10Ah at 5V.
voltage_caveat: At the upper contact resistance, Pi input can approach/breach its undervoltage threshold. A 3A wattage margin does not establish voltage stability.
mass_note: Actual sliced mass not computed; 30% infill does not imply 30% of this mass. Display mass budget 250-350g; other module/hardware mass assumptions recorded in README.

post_lateral_2g_check.scope: Ideal cantilever with equal load sharing; excludes base/root, layers, screws, seams, glass and impact. Not a drop rating.

cooling_sensitivity.scope: Energy balance, not CFD, CPU junction temperature or a fan/system operating point.

cost_usd.scope: Reference US retail observations and explicit planning allowances; excludes tax, shipping, tools, printing labour and any purchase. No user country or budget was assumed.

open_digital_fit_items: bank ports/button and built-in cable not dimensioned
keyboard underside/pad retention and cable bend not manufacturer CAD
GPIO extension connector rating and retention unverified
flexible cable bends/routing not solid interference verified
